title: docs
text:
docs

Alex (docs): quick heads-up — PR #4823 fixes the generate endpoint examples but I noticed the request body in docs still shows `max_tokens` as a string and the response schema is missing `request_id`. Can someone sanity-check?

Maria (platform): looking now. The spec change in https://github.com/redwood/schemas/pull/987 changed `metadata` to be nullable array; examples should show `[]` not `null` for JS clients. Also the headers section links to /samples/generate which is 404.

Sam (engineer): I patched the JS/Python SDK snippets in the branch. Main concern: code sample uses `const resp = await client.generate({ prompt, max_tokens: "50" })` — that string -> number will break typed clients.

Alex (docs): yep that's the one. Request: update examples to use numbers, mark fields nullable in schema description, and add a short migration blurb "legacy clients may send strings".

Natalie (docs): I'll combine schema and examples into one docs PR, add the migration note, and update the sample link. Assigning to @Sam for SDK snippets and @Maria for schema approval.

Sam (engineer): adding updated snippet now. Example curl I'm proposing:

```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate" \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" \ 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
  -d '{"model":"rw1-small","prompt":"hi","max_tokens":50,"metadata":[]} '
```

Note: I escaped the JSON above — replace with proper quoting in docs.

Maria (platform): schema PR updated; `metadata` is now `array|null` with description "Optional per-request key/value pairs" and example `[]`. I'm okay with docs change once samples link fixed.

Leo (ux): small ask — in the examples page can we add a one-line note under the curl snippet: "Use numbers for numeric params (max_tokens) to avoid SDK coercion issues" — it's helpful for new users.

DeployBot: docs-ci / build 4823 — docs build OK :white_check_mark: 

Alex (docs): thanks all. Natalie — if you can land the combined PR today, great. If not, open a follow-up to only fix the link + types so the change doesn't block releases.

Natalie (docs): will try to land today. I'll ping if I need a quick review. Thanks :pray:
